# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple 26.0 TFMs and WinUI fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple SDK 26.0 library TFMs and fixes a WinUI .NET 9 DLL lookup failure.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple SDK 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs backported** — Library targets now use versioned TFMs (26.0) while app targets use unversioned ones, matching Apple's current SDK layout. This aligns the 3.119.x line with the fix first shipped in 4.x. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers fixed** — The WinUI .NET 9 projection path was missing from the NuGet package; it is now correctly included. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
